## PM claim + dispatch order — R13, with the shape ruled

Claimed by the `domain:devx` @ objectui execution seat (#5748), round **R13**, PM session `session_019b5UBNMtTzKbVtZZGvFuxe`. Branch: `claude/issue-5996-eager-closure-missing-chunk`.

### Ruling: take shape 1. Shape 2 is investigation — **report it, do not fix it**.

The card offers two and recommends neither. Ruled:

**Shape 1** — guard the `fs.readFileSync` in `emitEagerClosureReport` with an existence check, and `this.error()` with a message that names the missing chunk file **and** says an unresolved bare import is the likely cause. That turns a bare Node `ENOENT` several frames from the real problem into a self-diagnosing failure, which is the spirit the module's own header already establishes with its two counter-probes.

**Shape 2** — why Rolldown emits a chunk entry for `pg-connection-string` at all rather than folding it into the importing chunk as a plain external, and whether an `advancedChunks.groups` test is unintentionally matching bare external specifiers. ⚠️ **Time-box this and report what you find; do not change chunking configuration.** Touching `advancedChunks` alters what ships to every user, and it would be a much larger change than this card's premise supports. If the investigation is inconclusive, saying so is a complete answer — file it as a follow-up card rather than guessing.

### ⚠️ The premise is partly spent — re-derive before you build

The card says this is *"not reachable via #5391's own path any more once that issue's fix lands"*. **PR #5995 (card #5391) merged today**, so that path is closed. Confirm that on current `origin/main`, then reproduce the crash by another route — the card names the `OBJECTSTACK_CLIENT_DIST` sibling hook as one.

⚠️ **If you cannot reproduce it at all, stop and report rather than building a guard against a hypothetical.** A guard that was never observed catching anything is a guard nobody can verify. Reproducing it — by whatever route — is the first deliverable and the thing the fix has to be shown against.

### Verification

- **Before/after on the same reproduction**, explicitly paired: the bare `ENOENT` first, then your named error. A fix never shown to change a failure is not verified.
- The new error must name the **missing chunk file** and point at the assumption — quote its exact text in the PR.
- ⚠️ **A build artifact sits between your edit and the thing under test**: the plugin runs in `writeBundle` during a real `vite build`. State how you rebuilt and how you know the artifact under test is the one you edited. This lane lost a round to a stale artifact today.
- **Non-vacuity**: prove the guard does not fire on a normal build. A check that errors on every chunk would "pass" your reproduction and break everything else.
- ⛔ Do not silence the failure. The crash being **loud** is the correct direction — the defect is that it is loud in the wrong place and about the wrong thing.

⛔ Out of scope: `advancedChunks` configuration, the spec-dist override validation (#5391, landed), and the eager-closure report's counting logic (#5324 / #5266).

⛔ Never `git stash` — shared stack, other agents are using it now.

Shape 1 implemented as ruled: the fs.readFileSync in emitEagerClosureReport is guarded by an existence check that this.error()s naming the missing file, the chunk that imports it, and the unresolved-bare-import diagnosis; the failure stays a build failure, only the message changed. Shape 2 investigated, nothing configured: the card's stated mechanism is FALSIFIED — rolldown does not emit a chunk entry for the specifier (inBundleMap false; 515 bundle keys = 508 chunks + 7 assets, none of them the specifier). It appears only inside assets/framework-*.js's `imports` array, because rolldown lists a chunk's EXTERNAL imports there beside real chunk file names, and the walk does eager.add() without asking chunks.has(). No advancedChunks.groups test matches these ids (no /node_modules/ and no /@objectstack+ segment), so the group-test suspicion is NOT supported. IMPORTANT CAVEAT for the PM: under the real console plugin stack neither the old ENOENT nor the new message reaches the developer — viteIneffectiveDynamicImports()'s closeBundle counter-probe replaces the reported build error whenever the build died earlier, so all the user sees is `43 pinned ineffective dynamic import(s) did NOT fire`. That masking is pre-existing, is a different plugin (#5325's ledger), and is filed as #6093; this fix is correct and demonstrated but stays invisible to developers until that lands.",

AFTER: 'Build failed with 1 error: [plugin emit-eager-closure-report] RolldownError: [emit-eager-closure-report] eager-closure member `@objectstack/core/logger` has no file in `.../apps/console/dist`, so its bytes cannot be weighed. It is almost certainly an UNRESOLVED BARE IMPORT ... (imported by: assets/framework-Bwcc-tp7.js) ...'. ARTIFACT FRESHNESS: vite compiles the config into .vite-temp/<config>.timestamp-<ms>-<rand>.mjs freshly per invocation — the two runs name different files in their stack traces (before.ts.timestamp-1787588787207-3d31ebadb622b.mjs vs after.ts.timestamp-1787588797390-b421aa65b219f.mjs), and the after text exists nowhere in the repo but this diff. NON-VACUITY: real vite.config.ts, no override, on b3e278420 exits 0 with '[plugin emit-eager-closure-report] eager closure: 52/508 chunks, 3298242 bytes gzipped (3220.9 KB)' — byte-identical to the pre-fix baseline on 7c96c9420, and grep -c of the guard text in that log is 0; measured reason it is silent: the only externals on a normal build are module/fs/path from @objectstack/lint, which sits behind the lazy boundary. GATES: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check` exit 0 (tsc --noEmit && tsc -b tsconfig.node.json --force; tsconfig.node.json is the project containing vite.config.ts) — the first run's 352 TS2882 errors were the unbuilt-dependency-closure trap, none naming vite.config.ts, and green after `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/console^...' build`. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console lint` exit 0 ('203 problems (0 errors, 203 warnings)', all pre-existing). Root vitest on the 6 config-adjacent suites: 'Test Files 6 passed (6)' / 'Tests 157 passed (157)'. `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: 'No source of a released package changed in this range, so no changeset is owed.' DECLARED NARROWING: the repo-wide suite and the full lint farm were not run locally; CI owns that verdict. All exit codes captured before any pipe (redirect-then-capture), and every verdict above is the gate's own printed line.",
  "open_questions": [],
  "out_of_scope_findings": [
    "filed as #6093: ineffective-dynamic-import-ledger's closeBundle counter-probe replaces the real error whenever an earlier console plugin fails the build — measured, the ENOENT/guard message appears 0 times under the real plugin list",
    "filed as #6094: OBJECTSTACK_CLIENT_DIST has no dependency-resolution validation (the asymmetry with OBJECTSTACK_SPEC_DIST after #5995), so an out-of-tree client override silently produces a bundle with bare specifiers no browser can load"
  ]
}
